messages:
anya_acct_mgr: Heads-up: CareBridge raised a dispute on their July private invoice. They say platform fee increased after a support-tier upgrade and renewal. Procurement paused payment.
billing-bot: Invoice #CB-2026-07 generated 2026-07-03T09:02Z. platform_fee: $54,600; support_tier: enterprise; last_change: 2026-07-01 upgrade -> enterprise-plus.
marc_billing: tagging FIN-5210. Anya, did the upgrade effective date land before the monthly rollup? Could be proration + full month overlap.
anya_acct_mgr: The upgrade was signed 2026-06-30 and effective 2026-07-01 per amendment AM-338. Customer expects prorated charge for 7/1-7/31 at new tier only, not both old and new fees.
leo_engops: pulling billing events for resource cb-vpc-prod. Quick query: `SELECT id, ts, amount, kind FROM billing_events WHERE resource='cb-vpc-prod' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY ts;`
leo_engops: results: bf-13001 monthly_old_tier $28,000 (2026-07-01 00:00), bf-13002 prorate_upgrade $14,300 (2026-07-01 01:05), bf-13003 monthly_new_tier $28,300 (2026-07-01 00:05). Looks like both monthly_old_tier and monthly_new_tier ran around the same rollup window.
julia_finance: That would explain the ~95% jump. Finance can approve a provisional credit equal to the duplicate monthly_old_tier if ops confirms. Approve up to $29k. GL: CU-CR-TIER.
marc_billing: I'll mark invoice CB-2026-07 disputed and draft provisional credit CM-CB-2026-07-P for $28,000 pending confirmation. Approve @julia_finance?
julia_finance: Approved provisional_credit_amount: "$28,000". Post as pending. We'll review final backfill results before posting ledger.
leo_engops: Root cause: upgrade workflow created a prorate event but the monthly rollup didn't check for in-flight tier changes; race condition at 00:00 UTC. Fix: add a lock and a flag `skip_prior_monthly=true` when prorate created. PR #4898 open. Scheduling cleanup backfill backfill-cb-2210 to remove bf-13001.
anya_acct_mgr: Draft customer note: "We've placed a provisional credit of $28,000 against invoice CB-2026-07 while we investigate an overlap between your tier upgrade prorate and the monthly rollup. We'll confirm final numbers within 48 hours and won't impact your renewal discussions." OK to send?
marc_billing: Send it with FIN-5210 ref. Also include CM reference when created.
leo_engops: Backfill finished; removed duplicate bf-13001. Delta = -$28,000. ENG-BILL-245 resolved.
marc_billing: Creating credit memo CM-CB-2026-07-1 for $28,000 and attaching to CB-2026-07. Invoice set to adjusted.
julia_finance: Finance to post GL CU-CR-TIER $28,000 once CM processes. We'll sign off when ledger entry appears.
anya_acct_mgr: Customer replied: "Thanks, procurement cleared payment. Appreciate the quick handling." Closing loop from account.
marc_billing: Postmortem: add test for upgrade-at-midnight path, add a nightly audit for same-resource multiple platform_fee events, update billing runbook. Owners: leo_engops, marc_billing, julia_finance. FIN-5210 -> resolved.
